'''''Kappa''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used during the [[Raid in the Rudrig system]].
